title: Lesotho — Company Income Tax Return (Form S128-C)
description: Revenue Services Lesotho's (RSL) Form S128-C, "Company Income Tax Return for Year Ended 31 March 2023" — a companion to ls/rsl/individual-income-tax-return within Lesotho's Taxes vertical (already open, 2 of 6). Resident companies, non-resident companies, and Lesotho branches of non-resident companies use this annual return to reconcile chargeable income (manufacturing, commercial farming, and other business income, plus property, investment, and foreign-source income) and compute tax due or overpaid for the year. This v1.0.0 schema is scoped to the core declaration a Lesotho-resident company with only Lesotho-source business income completes: Details of Company, Part A (Lesotho-Source Business Income & Expenses), Part D (Chargeable Income, Lesotho-source lines only), Part F (Tax Computation), and the Declaration of Paid Preparer / Declaration of Nominated Officer sections. Part B (Foreign-Source Business Income & Expenses), Part C (Property & Other Income and Expenses), Part E (Credit for Foreign Tax Paid), and Part G (Related Parties Transactions Reporting) are out of scope for this version and deferred to a future minor version. GovSchema is an independent, non-profit standards body and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the Government of Lesotho or Revenue Services Lesotho.

verification.notes: GOV-4762 ("GovSchema Standard Research"). Companion schema to ls/rsl/individual-income-tax-return (GOV-4755), which disclosed this form as open backlog in RSL's own "Forms & Instructions" library. The PDF was fetched live and unauthenticated from rsl.org.ls (317,637 bytes). The form is a flat (non-fillable, non-XFA) 6-page PDF with no AcroForm annotations; all fields were reconstructed from the rendered page images (node-canvas at 2.5x scale) cross-checked against the pdfjs-dist text layer, which was found consistent with the visual layout for this specimen (unlike the individual return's own ghost-text finding). See this document's own VERIFICATION.md for the full sourcing record.

steps.title: Part A - Lesotho-Source Business Income & Expenses

fields.name: substitutedAccountingDate
fields.label: Enter approved substituted accounting date if different from above (day, month, year)
fields.description: Only completed by a company with RSL-approved substituted accounting date (an accounting year-end other than 31 March).

fields.name: companyResidencyStatus
fields.label: Tick/circle applicable box(es) — Resident company / Non-resident company / Lesotho branch of non-resident company
fields.description: The company's residency classification for the tax year. Mutually exclusive with the "Lesotho branch of non-resident company" case treated as its own option (a branch is not itself a resident or a standalone non-resident company).
fields.sourceRef: Page 1, DETAILS OF COMPANY, "Tick/circle applicable box(es)"

fields.name: finalReturn
fields.label: Final return (out of business)
fields.description: Ticked when this is the company's final return because it has ceased business. Independent of companyResidencyStatus — the source form allows ticking multiple boxes.
fields.sourceRef: Page 1, DETAILS OF COMPANY, "Final return (out of business)"

fields.name: tin
fields.label: TIN
fields.description: The company's Taxpayer Identification Number, printed as a comb-box field.

fields.name: nominatedOfficerNameAndDesignation
fields.label: Name and designation of nominated officer
fields.description: The individual the company has nominated as responsible officer for this return; this same person signs the Declaration of Nominated Officer.

fields.name: manufacturingIncome
fields.label: 1(a). Business income — Manufacturing Income (Resident Companies only)
fields.description: Sales/turnover, investments, interest, premiums, gains from business assets, etc., including net business income from partnerships, trusts, and estates (attach schedule). Applicable only to resident companies; non-resident companies and Lesotho branches leave this column blank.

fields.name: manufacturingNetProfitOrLoss
fields.label: 3. Current year net profit or loss (line 1-2) — Manufacturing Income (a)

fields.name: farmingIncomeLesotho
fields.label: 1(b). Business income — Commercial Farming Income
fields.description: Lesotho-source commercial farming income, including net income from partnerships, trusts, and estates (attach schedule).

fields.name: farmingNetProfitOrLossLesotho
fields.label: 3. Current year net profit or loss (line 1-2) — Commercial Farming Income (b)

fields.name: otherBusinessIncomeLesotho
fields.label: 1(c). Business income — Other Business Income
fields.description: Lesotho-source business income other than manufacturing or commercial farming, including net business income from partnerships, trusts, and estates (attach schedule).

fields.name: otherBusinessNetProfitOrLossLesotho
fields.label: 3. Current year net profit or loss (line 1-2) — Other Business Income (c)

fields.name: manufacturingIncomeOrLossPartD
fields.label: 1(a). Enter manufacturing income or loss from Part A, line 3, col. (a)

fields.name: manufacturingLossesBroughtForward
fields.label: 1(b). Enter manufacturing losses brought forward from prior years

fields.name: chargeableManufacturingIncome
fields.label: 1(c). Chargeable manufacturing income (1a-1b). If zero or less, enter nil

fields.name: farmingIncomeOrLossLesothoPartD
fields.label: 2(a). Enter Lesotho-source commercial farming income or loss from Part A, line 3, col. (b)

fields.name: farmingLossesBroughtForwardLesotho
fields.label: 2(b). Enter Lesotho-source commercial farming losses from prior years

fields.name: chargeableFarmingIncomeLesotho
fields.label: 2(c). Chargeable commercial farming income (2a-2b). If zero or less, enter nil

fields.name: otherBusinessIncomeOrLossLesothoPartD
fields.label: 3(a). Enter other Lesotho-source business income or loss from Part A, line 3, col. (c)

fields.name: propertyOtherIncomeOrLossLesothoPartD
fields.label: 3(b). Enter Lesotho-source property & other income or loss from Part C, line 8, col. (a)
fields.description: Pass-through total from Part C (Property & Other Income and Expenses), which is out of scope for this schema version. A company with such income can still record Part C's own final total here; the detailed schedule build-up is deferred to a future minor version.

fields.name: businessPropertyOtherLossesBroughtForwardLesotho
fields.label: 3(d). Enter Lesotho-source, business, property, and other losses from prior years

fields.name: chargeableBusinessPropertyOtherIncomeLesotho
fields.label: 3(e). Chargeable Lesotho-source business, property and other income. Subtract line (d) from line (c). If zero or less, enter nil

fields.name: taxComputationManufacturingIncome
fields.label: 1(a). Enter in col. (a) manufacturing income from Part D, line 1c

fields.name: taxComputationFarmingIncomeLesotho
fields.label: 1(b). Enter in col. (a) Lesotho-source commercial farming income from Part D, line 2c

fields.name: resident109Election
fields.label: Non-resident companies electing under section 109 to be taxed by assessment must use a tax rate of 40%
fields.description: When true, the 40% rate (rather than the standard 25%) applies to taxComputationOtherTaxLesotho. Only relevant to non-resident companies.
fields.sourceRef: Page 4, PART F, item 1c note, "*Non-resident companies electing under section 109..."

fields.name: taxComputationOtherIncomeLesotho
fields.label: 1(c). Enter in col. (a) Lesotho-source business, property and other income from Part D, line 3e

fields.name: totalTaxBeforeCreditsIncome
fields.label: 2. Total tax before credits — column (a): add 1a+1b+1c+1d+1e
fields.description: This schema models only the Lesotho-source rows (1a-1c); the foreign-source rows (1d-1e) are out of scope (see Part B/Part D section 4 deferral) and assumed nil for a company with no foreign-source income.

fields.name: totalTaxBeforeCreditsTax
fields.label: 2. Total tax before credits — column (c): add 1b+1c+1d+1e+1f

fields.name: creditForForeignTaxPaid
fields.label: 3(a). Credit for foreign tax paid from Part E, line 2
fields.description: Pass-through total from Part E (Credit for Foreign Tax Paid), which is out of scope for this schema version and assumed nil for a company with no foreign-source income.

fields.name: advanceInstallmentIncomeTaxPaid
fields.label: 3(c). Advance installment of income tax paid

fields.name: taxDue
fields.label: 5. Tax due. Line 2 minus line 4. Enter nil if less than -0-

fields.name: taxOverpaid
fields.label: 6. Tax overpaid. Line 4 minus line 2. Enter nil if less than -0-

fields.name: claimingRepaymentOfOverpaidTax
fields.label: If you are claiming repayment of the tax overpaid as shown on this line, tick this box
fields.description: When ticked, proof of banking details from the company's bank must be attached.

fields.name: paidPreparerName
fields.label: Name of paid preparer
fields.description: Declaration of Paid Preparer (external tax consultant/accountant/auditor). Skip this section if there is no paid preparer.

fields.name: officerTin
fields.label: TIN [of nominated officer]
fields.description: The nominated officer's own Taxpayer Identification Number, distinct from the company's TIN entered in Details of Company.

fields.name: declarationDate
fields.label: Date (day, month, year) [nominated officer]
fields.description: The date the nominated officer signs the declaration that the return is correct and complete, and (if applicable) confirms having ticked the repayment box on Part F, line 6.

fields.name: officerPostalAddress
fields.label: Postal address of officer (P/Bag or P.O Box)

fields.name: previousOfficerChangeDate
fields.label: Date of change (day, month, year) [if nominated officer changed during the year of assessment]
fields.description: Only completed when the company changed its nominated officer during the year of assessment. The source form has no separate yes/no checkbox for this scenario, so it is not requiredWhen-gated on previousOfficerName — see this registry's own notEquals-empty-string-absent-field anti-pattern notes.
fields.sourceRef: Page 6, Declaration of Nominated Officer, "If there has been a change of nominated officer..."

fields.name: previousOfficerName
fields.label: Name of previous nominated officer
fields.sourceRef: Page 6, Declaration of Nominated Officer, "If there has been a change of nominated officer..."

documents.label: Schedule of net business income from partnerships, trusts, and estates (if applicable)
Proof of banking details from the company's bank
